entities.summary: James Batemon III is an American professional basketball player plays for Força Lleida of the Spanish Liga ACB. He played college basketball for North Dakota State College of Science and Loyola Marymount before playing professionally in Latvia, France, Greece, Germany, Israel, Australia and Spain. In 2022, he was named the LNB Pro B Most Valuable Player.
